in_marathi.name: Chandran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandran is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chandra', which means 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, Chandran is the name of the moon god. The moon is revered as a symbol of calmness, peace, and prosperity. This name is believed to bring good fortune, wisdom, and protection.
